title: Price change limit can cause system DoS
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  In Elytra, we will have one default price percentage limit, 10%. If the difference between the current price and updated price exceeds the price limit, deposit/withdraw will be blocked.  If there is something wrong with one LST, which causes the share's price drops, e.g 10%. This will block deposit/withdraw. This is one expected behavior.
